WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM film_rated_admission WHERE film_id=? AND tmdb=? AND source_code=? AND archive_sha256=? AND title IS ? AND year IS ? AND receipt_key=? AND receipt_film_key=? AND verified_at=? AND request_id=?)
